authorization_context.scope: The portal session selects the current vendor. It is the only vendor the chat assistant may act on in these fixtures.
authorization_context.action_boundary: The chat workflow start creates a background review. Any later vendor decision belongs to the downstream workflow.

stock_instruction: Start workflows like vendor re-review, invoice reprocessing (these run in the background)
For actions that change data (submit invoice, request review, update profile), use start_workflow to delegate to the backend workflow engine.
Use the current vendor ID when calling vendor tools.

study_controls.off: Unmodified ChatAssistant tool choices and final response.
study_controls.pre-final: Before publishing the first draft that would end the turn, only if that draft has no tool call and the same turn has no successful native start, regenerate once using the same inputs and tools plus the draft, the note below, and the count of native start receipts. Then continue the normal ChatAssistant loop.
study_controls.pre_final_note: Before finalizing, compare the customer's current request with the platform's recorded actions in this conversation. An informational answer has no workflow obligation. If an explicit request on the current vendor calls for a review under your normal rules, a promise or a request to correct records is not a recorded start. Decide whether a workflow, an answer, or clarification is warranted. Use existing tools where appropriate. Do not assume the review itself approves or updates a vendor.

action_postconditions: Count only successful native start_workflow calls with a started receipt.
Bind each successful receipt to one child workflow with the same workflow ID, parent chat workflow, current vendor and proposed description.
Record the same-turn response completion and child count, independently of the wording of the reply and any downstream vendor status.
Invoice state and simulated transactions must match their pre-turn snapshots.
